text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear paragraphing with repeated topic sentences","quality":"organization","description":"The essay groups ideas into a more controlled sequence with clearer paragraph-level progression."},{"evidence":"linked phrases like \"so,\" \"Also,\" \"In addition,\" and \"That being said\"","quality":"cohesive transitions","description":"It uses more explicit connecting language to move between points and examples."},{"evidence":"longer explanatory sentences with cause-effect logic","quality":"development","description":"It more often expands claims with reasons, consequences, and elaboration rather than repeating the same point."},{"evidence":"personal example about arriving in the United States in 2017","quality":"relevant illustration","description":"It includes a concrete personal anecdote that supports the main idea and makes the argument more vivid."},{"evidence":"\"I can speak, write and read very well\"","quality":"sentence control","description":"It shows somewhat better control of sentence construction, even though there are still errors."},{"evidence":"wording such as \"true self-esteem,\" \"self confident,\" and \"achieve their goals\"","quality":"academic vocabulary","description":"It uses more topic-appropriate language connected to the prompt and to abstract ideas."}]}
